_about: Sprint 10c permisos gold set (plan §D.10). Hand-built from REAL 'Artículo — Permisos/Licencias retribuidas' passages pulled live from staging (document_pages, document_type=convenio_text, retrieval_status=active), verified line-by-line against the real text (see quotes/ for the raw pulled pages). Unlike 7b-2's gold set (cross-province scope matching), this driver is SINGLE-CONVENIO per call — 'scope' correctness here means (a) the proposed fact's convenio_id is the call's own convenio (structurally near-guaranteed by the single-candidate binding, but asserted directly per the 0-tolerance gate) and (b) the model did NOT extract content belonging to a DIFFERENT topic that happens to share the word 'permiso' (the real trap this pull surfaced: lactancia/maternidad/paternidad clauses live inside or beside the same 'Permisos'/'Licencias' article in several real convenios). Each entry is matched to a proposed fact by KEYWORD, not group/scope (permisos facts are almost never group-split in this corpus).
